item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Repaint Only the Car

turns.text: Can you make the red car navy blue? Leave the rest of the photo alone.

item.tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

answer_sheet.New colour: Navy blue, retaining the original paint finish and reflections.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Other changes or text: None. Leave everything except the red body paint unchanged.

must_haves: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.

turns.text: can you change the car colour in this pic

dialog.agent:
Sure, I can recolour the red hatchback. **What colour would you like?** For example:

- Matte black
- Pearl white
- Metallic silver or grey
- Navy or electric blue
- British racing green
- Something custom, like "pastel mint" or "a two-tone white roof with a blue body"

Tell me the colour and I'll make the edit. The background, the other cars and the lighting will stay as they are. It'll come out at 640px, which is the size your free plan allows.
dialog.why: The assistant asks which colour the user wants and waits before making the edit; the note about plan size is only a caveat, not a refusal or an inability.
dialog.user: navy blue. keep the shine and reflections like it has now

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the navy blue version. Magic Hour turned down the edit because your account doesn't have enough credits for it, so no image was created.

I used the cheapest option your free plan allows (5 credits per image at 640px), so switching to another free model won't get around it. To continue, you'd need to:

- **Wait for your free credits to top up**, if your plan refreshes them, or
- **Add credits or upgrade** in your Magic Hour account.

Once you have credits, tell me and I'll run the same edit. It changes only the car's paint to a deep glossy navy and keeps the shine, sun reflections and shading. The tail lights, windows, wheels, number plate, shadow and background stay as they are.
